alerts._note: SECURE setup (keep this field EMPTY): the webhook URL stays OUT of this committed file. Box side -> put it in secrets/teams-webhook-url.txt (gitignored) or the TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL env var. GitHub Actions side -> repo secret TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL (Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions). fire_alert.py + liveness.yml + heartbeat.yml all read the secret; this field is only a discouraged last-resort fallback (anything pasted here lands in git history). Create the webhook: Teams channel > ... > Connectors > Incoming Webhook > copy URL. Empty teams_webhook_url = alerts still queue to reports/alerts-queue.json.
